infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Used to share your location with emergency contacts when an alert is triggered.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: The app needs background location to include your position in emergency alerts even when backgrounded.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Background location is required to send your coordinates in emergency alerts.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: The app uses motion sensors to detect emergency gestures such as shaking or falling.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Safety Emergency App to use your location to share with emergency contacts.

plugins.motionPermission: Allow Safety Emergency App to access motion sensors for gesture detection.

plugins.photosPermission: The app accesses your photos to let you upload a profile picture.
